race_instances.title: Spawner sees node before controller-manager services are ready
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainer merged PR #683, changing readiness checks from node discovery to controller-manager service availability.
race_instances.actor_1_access: checks node/services and starts controller operations
race_instances.actor_2_access: creates node and later advertises services
race_instances.trigger_condition: Spawner observes the node in the interval before required services become available.
race_instances.evidence_summary: The fix waits for controller-manager services instead of treating node discovery as readiness.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Ordering/readiness race, not a C++ memory data race.

race_instances.title: Humble diagnostics and update access lifecycle state concurrently
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Developers state that Humble lifecycle-state access is not thread safe; maintainer merged PR #1015.
race_instances.file_path: controller_manager diagnostics and controller lifecycle state access
race_instances.actor_2_access: reads or changes controller state during update
race_instances.trigger_condition: Diagnostics callback overlaps the real-time update path on Humble.
race_instances.detection_method: Crash reproduction and developer thread-safety analysis
race_instances.evidence_summary: The diagnostics callback and update path accessed a lifecycle-state implementation that was not thread safe in Humble.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Strict classification is likely but no public TSan trace was attached; confidence is medium.
race_instances.strict_reason: Potentially concurrent non-atomic lifecycle-state accesses without a demonstrated happens-before relation.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No synchronization between diagnostic callback and update loop was identified.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: Issue and merged fix identify diagnostic callback versus update execution.

race_instances.title: robot_description callback initializes ResourceManager during read/write
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: PR #1451 explains that ResourceManager initialization was outside resources_lock_ while read/write continued; maintainer merged it.
race_instances.trigger_condition: Robot description arrives after the real-time read/write loop has started.
race_instances.evidence_summary: The callback path bypassed an existing resources_lock_ used to coordinate resource access.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Different paths had an intended lock, making R2 more precise than complete absence of synchronization.
race_instances.strict_reason: The callback mutates ResourceManager storage while read/write accesses the same non-atomic state.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: The callback path was not covered by resources_lock_ before the fix.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: PR explicitly contrasts subscription initialization with continuing read/write.

race_instances.title: Concurrent spawners interleave load/configure/activate transactions
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PRs #1949 and #2202 progressively serialize spawner operations; #2202 reports repeatable failure without the file lock and stable stress tests with it.
race_instances.actor_1: spawner process A and its service callbacks
race_instances.actor_2: spawner process B and its service callbacks
race_instances.impact: One or more controllers fail to start.
race_instances.evidence_summary: The multi-step controller startup operation was not transactionally serialized across spawner processes.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Cross-process semantic atomicity violation rather than a C++ memory race.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: Concurrent service transactions are necessary for the reported failure.

race_instances.title: Configure timeout retry overlaps an in-flight configure callback
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: PR #2073 was merged and reporter confirmed it fixed the failure; discussion explains that the timed-out server callback was still running when retry began.
race_instances.trigger_condition: High CPU load makes the client time out while the first callback continues.
race_instances.impact: Duplicate interface export and controller-manager crash.
race_instances.evidence_summary: A client timeout did not cancel server work, so retry created overlapping configure transactions.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Idempotency/transaction race; public evidence does not establish unsynchronized memory accesses.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: Two executions of the configure service callback overlap.

race_instances.title: RQT controller-manager CM-list timer overlaps plugin shutdown
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR #3396 explicitly states that it fixes several shutdown races and handles each timer path.
race_instances.shared_object: controller-manager list timer and rclpy context/node
race_instances.actor_1_access: uses node/context and updates UI data
race_instances.trigger_condition: Plugin shutdown overlaps a pending CM-list timer tick.
race_instances.evidence_summary: Shutdown could invalidate rclpy state while this timer callback was executing.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Python/Qt teardown ordering race; strict C++ data-race definition is not established.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: PR names the timer and shutdown path.

race_instances.title: RQT controller-list timer overlaps plugin shutdown
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR #3396 explicitly states that it fixes several shutdown races and separately stops this timer.
race_instances.actor_1_access: uses node/context and updates UI data
race_instances.trigger_condition: Plugin shutdown overlaps a pending controller-list timer tick.
race_instances.duplicate_of: R2C-2026-001 (shared fix family, distinct timer object)
race_instances.evidence_summary: Shutdown could invalidate rclpy state while this timer callback was executing.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Counted separately because the PR identifies a distinct timer object and callback path.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: PR names the timer and shutdown path.

race_instances.title: RQT hardware-components timer overlaps plugin shutdown
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR #3396 states that the hardware timer was omitted from shutdown and fixes the resulting shutdown race.
race_instances.actor_1_access: uses node/context and updates UI data
race_instances.actor_2_access: destroys context/node without previously stopping this timer
race_instances.trigger_condition: Plugin shutdown overlaps the omitted hardware-components timer.
race_instances.duplicate_of: R2C-2026-001 (shared fix family, distinct timer object)
race_instances.evidence_summary: This timer had a separate object and was not stopped during shutdown before the fix.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Counted separately because the shared object and timer path are distinct.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: PR identifies the omitted timer as a separate shutdown race.

race_instances.title: Synchronous controller update continues while shutdown releases interfaces
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Member reports the production crash; PR #3549 identifies and TSan-tests the synchronous shutdown path.
race_instances.class_function: ControllerManager::update; pre-shutdown/lifecycle callback; controller interface release
race_instances.shared_object: controller interfaces and state used by synchronous update
race_instances.actor_2_access: releases interfaces and cleans controller state
race_instances.trigger_condition: Shutdown begins while the control thread is inside read/update/write.
race_instances.impact: std::out_of_range or crash from invalid controller state.
race_instances.detection_method: Production crash and TSan regression test
race_instances.evidence_summary: Shutdown can release interfaces before the synchronous update path has stopped.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Issue #2975 is treated as another manifestation of this synchronous path, not an additional instance.
race_instances.strict_reason: Update accesses non-atomic controller/interface storage while lifecycle shutdown mutates or destroys it.
race_instances.memory_location: controller interface containers and controller-owned state
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: PR adds coordination because no shutdown/update ordering previously existed.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: PR explicitly separates synchronous update versus shutdown race.

race_instances.title: Asynchronous controller callback outlives ControllerManager update during shutdown
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: PR #3549 explicitly separates an asynchronous-controller callback path and reports baseline TSan findings removed by the proposed coordination.
race_instances.shared_object: controller interfaces/state owned by asynchronous update
race_instances.actor_2_access: releases interfaces and cleans controller state
race_instances.trigger_condition: ControllerManager::update returns while an asynchronous callback is still executing and shutdown begins.
race_instances.impact: Controller update after cleanup, invalid map access or crash.
race_instances.detection_method: TSan regression test and crash reproduction
race_instances.duplicate_of: R2C-2025-002 (same repair family, distinct asynchronous path)
race_instances.evidence_summary: The asynchronous callback can remain alive after the manager update returns and overlap shutdown.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Counted separately from the synchronous path because the concurrency window and execution owner differ.
race_instances.strict_reason: An async callback accesses non-atomic controller state while shutdown mutates or destroys it.
race_instances.memory_location: async controller interface and state storage
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No join/coordination guaranteed callback completion before shutdown.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: PR explicitly identifies the async callback as a separate path.

race_instances.title: ForceTorqueSensor update overlaps release_interfaces
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: PR #3492 gives the exact vector-clear/read path and has substantive maintainer review.
race_instances.trigger_condition: A last update tick overlaps deactivation.
race_instances.evidence_summary: release_interfaces clears the vector while the update callback still indexes it.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Distinct from generic manager shutdown because it is a concrete semantic-component vector.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent vector clear and element read/index on the same non-atomic container storage.
race_instances.memory_location: ForceTorqueSensor state_interfaces vector and backing storage
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No update/deactivation completion barrier before the proposed fix.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: PR specifies update callback versus lifecycle release.

race_instances.title: updated_controllers_index_ races between RT update and non-RT list switch
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Issue identifies the unsynchronized index; PR #3557 changes it to std::atomic and reports TSan 20/20 clean runs after the change.
race_instances.trigger_condition: Controller list switch overlaps the real-time update loop.
race_instances.impact: TSan report and undefined controller-list handoff behavior.
race_instances.evidence_summary: The non-atomic index is accessed by RT and non-RT paths; proposed fix makes it atomic.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Issue #3083 is a new TSan reproduction of the same production variable, not a new race.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent non-atomic accesses to the same integer index without synchronization.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No synchronization before proposed atomic conversion.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: Management service/switch callback overlaps RT update.

race_instances.title: used_by_realtime_controllers_index_ races between RT and non-RT owners
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Issue and TSan follow-up identify the second independent index; PR #3557 converts it to std::atomic with explicit load/store protocol.
race_instances.actor_2_access: reads/writes the same index and waits for handoff
race_instances.trigger_condition: Controller list switch overlaps the real-time update loop.
race_instances.impact: TSan report and undefined handoff behavior.
race_instances.duplicate_of: R2C-2023-002 (same fix family, distinct shared variable)
race_instances.evidence_summary: A second non-atomic handoff index is independently accessed by RT and non-RT paths.
race_instances.researcher_inference: Counted separately because it is a different memory location with its own conflicting accesses.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent non-atomic accesses to the same integer index without synchronization.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No synchronization before proposed atomic conversion.
race_instances.callback_causality_evidence: Management service/switch callback overlaps RT update.
